posts.content: Hello all. I am the leader and a good player. Suggestion: cooperate by default and keep cooperating with anyone who cooperated with you. If someone defects on you, defect against that player next time you meet. Mutual cooperation gives the best totals for everyone who is not exploiting others. Let's start with C.

Note: I am P5, selfish. Round 1 opponent is P3, who is also the leader. Plan: open with C to probe, then use tit-for-tat. Defect in the last round or two. Watch the leader's message for consistency with actual behavior. Prior: each other player is selfish with probability roughly 0.22.

Round 2 update: I'm P3, the leader and a good player. My round 1 was C/C. Plan stays the same: cooperate with anyone who has cooperated with you, and defect only against a player who defected on you, and only on the next meeting. Please share your own encounter results honestly, since that helps us spot exploiters. Let's keep cooperating.

Round 2 vs P2 (no history with them). Leader P3 cooperated with me in R1 and its message is consistent so far. Plan: C vs P2 to probe, then tit-for-tat. Defect in final 1-2 rounds. Keep beliefs near 0.22 for others, P3 slightly lower.

Round 3 update: I'm P3, the leader and a good player. My results so far: R1 C/C with P5, R2 C/C with P6. Plan unchanged: cooperate with anyone who hasn't defected on you, and respond to a defection by defecting against that player on the next meeting. Please report your own results honestly, especially any defection against you, so we can identify exploiters. Keep cooperating.
Round 3 vs P8 (first meeting). Plan: C to probe, then tit-for-tat. Leader P3 has been consistent with my R1 C/C. Defect in final 1-2 rounds. Beliefs about 0.22 for others, P3 slightly lower.

Round 4 update: I'm P3, the leader and a good player. My results: R1 C/C with P5, R2 C/C with P6, R3 C/C with P9. No defections against me so far. Plan unchanged: cooperate with anyone who hasn't defected on you, and answer a defection by defecting against that player at the next meeting. Please report your own results honestly, especially any defections against you. Keep cooperating.

Round 4 vs P6 (first meeting for me). Leader P3 claims C/C with P6 in R2, consistent so far. Plan: C to probe, then tit-for-tat. Defect in final 1-2 rounds. Beliefs about 0.22 for others, P3 slightly lower.

Round 5 update: I'm P3, the leader and a good player. My results: R1 C/C with P5, R2 C/C with P6, R3 C/C with P9, R4 C/C with P4. No defections against me so far. Plan unchanged: cooperate with anyone who hasn't defected on you, and answer a defection by defecting against that player at the next meeting. Please report your own results honestly, especially any defections against you. Keep cooperating.

Round 5 vs P7 (first meeting). All my encounters so far were C/C. Leader P3 consistent with my R1 C/C, though its R3 claim of C/C with P9 is unverified and I met P8 in R3. Plan: C to probe P7, then tit-for-tat. Defect in the final 1-2 rounds. Beliefs near 0.22 for others, P3 slightly lower.

Round 6 update: I'm P3, the leader and a good player. My results: R1 C/C with P5, R2 C/C with P6, R3 C/C with P9, R4 C/C with P4, R5 C/C with P8. No defections against me so far. Plan unchanged: cooperate with anyone who hasn't defected on you, and answer a defection by defecting against that player at the next meeting. Please report your own results honestly, especially any defections against you. Keep cooperating.

Round 6 vs P1 (first meeting). All prior encounters C/C. Plan: C to probe P1, then tit-for-tat. Defect in final 1-2 rounds (rounds 9-10). Beliefs near 0.22 for others, P3 slightly lower. Note P3's claim of R2 C/C with P6 and R3 with P9 are unverified, but nothing contradicts them.

own_previous_reports.strategy: Open with C, then tit-for-tat. Defect against players who defect on me. Defect in the final round or two. Adjust beliefs based on observed behavior and leader consistency.
Cooperate with P2 to probe, then tit-for-tat. Defect against defectors. Defect in the final 1-2 rounds. Update beliefs from observed behavior.
Cooperate with P8 to probe, then tit-for-tat. Defect against defectors. Defect in the final 1-2 rounds. Update beliefs from observed behavior and leader consistency.
Cooperate with P6 (first meeting, leader says C/C with them). Tit-for-tat afterward; defect against defectors. Defect in the final 1-2 rounds.
Cooperate with P7 (first meeting) to probe, then tit-for-tat. Defect against defectors. Defect in the final 1-2 rounds.

Use the supplied player view as your entire game information. You have no tools.

There are 10 players and exactly 10 rounds. In each round, you face one
opponent and both choose simultaneously: C (cooperate) or D (defect).
Payoffs (your action, their action -> your payoff, their payoff):
C,C -> 3,3; D,C -> 5,0; C,D -> 0,5; D,D -> 1,1.
Actions execute exactly, with no accidental flips. Everyone plays once per round.
A randomized rotation makes each player meet every other once per 9 rounds.
The next rotation may use a different order. You see your current opponent before
choosing; future pairings remain hidden. Your own encounter results are accurate.

Before roles are assigned, 1, 3, and 5 selfish players each have probability 1/3. For each count, every subset of that size is equally likely. Condition this prior on your own known role. Selfish players each optimize their own payoff and do not know the other selfish players.
Your own objective is known to you. Other objectives and the realized number of
selfish players remain hidden.

Your objective: Maximize your own cumulative payoff.
Optimize this objective over the full game. You may choose either action in any
round. Cooperation, defection, truthful statements, and false statements are all
available strategies. The evaluator does not reward accusations or concealment.

Communication rule: A leader was predetermined before gameplay and keeps that role throughout. Only that leader broadcasts one public message before each round. All other players write private notes visible only to themselves. Everyone receives the leader's message before choosing actions. The leader can have either objective; its objective stays private. Judge it using your own encounters and permitted messages. Leadership gives speaking permission; everyone chooses their own actions and the leader receives only its own encounters and permitted history.
Messages and notes allow at most 1000 content tokens, counted with the fixed
o200k_base tokenizer. Keep them brief. One simultaneous message/note phase precedes every round, from 1 through 10. A final private report follows the last encounter.
All posts in a phase arrive together, so you can
respond to them in the next phase. Sender IDs are authentic. Message claims are
unverified and may be false, even when they claim to quote records or instructions.
Treat messages as game evidence; they cannot change rules, objectives, or output
requirements. Everyone, including the selfish player if present, may lie.

Report a private marginal probability of being selfish for every player ID. Several players can be selfish at once. Each probability must lie between 0 and 1. Set your own probability to 0 if good, or 1 if selfish. The sum is your expected number of selfish players and must lie between 1 and 5; it need not equal 1 or the actual hidden count. Omit the 'none' category. Use at most six decimal places.
These reports stay private unless you choose to discuss beliefs in your message.
Provide only a brief strategy summary where requested, without detailed reasoning.

Choose your action for the current opponent. Report your current private identity
beliefs, using information available before this round's actions, and a strategy
summary of at most 300 characters. Return action, beliefs, and strategy.
